title: AdaMix over logical Mirror adaptations
hypothesis: A stochastic mixture of four logical Mirror views over one shared 2x2 adaptation basis will match four independent AdaMix adapters on routed fresh skills with lower actual bytes, while merged single-adapter inference retains comparable average quality.
mirror_coordinate: four learned Givens view angles, one per logical adaptation component
controls: AdaMix-style four independent adapters trained under stochastic component sampling
AdaMix independent adapters merged by arithmetic average at inference
Mirror views routed by skill ID
Mirror views merged to one average adapter

task.mixture: three skills are rotations of one shared basis; one off-orbit residual skill
task.training: 1,000 stochastic skill/component updates; component ID is sampled from the balanced skill mixture

development.selection: fixed stochastic update budget; no fresh tuning

paid_objects: all independent adapter matrices or shared Mirror basis and angles

success_gate: Every fresh world: routed Mirror NRMSE <=1.10x routed AdaMix at <=60% N4 payload, and merged Mirror NRMSE <=1.10x merged AdaMix.
failure_gate: Mirror misses routed quality/byte gate, merged inference degrades beyond gate, or a shared/no-view control matches Mirror at fewer bytes.
boundaries: Skill IDs are provided equally to routed controls.
No natural language or Transformer evidence.
